liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Althea** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls Althea nice; Reviewer calls this Althea hot [5][15]
- **China Doll** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it the greatest China Doll ever, the only one ending with a jam like this; Reviewer, who attended, calls this China Doll remarkable; it was only their second [6][8]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Reviewer ranks it among the best Friend of the Devil versions they have heard [15]
- **Beat It On Down The Line** (1 review): Reviewer considers this a good version of the song [5]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer calls this Let It Grow white hot [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **Mexicali**: back after 112 archived shows (420 days); rare: 14 archived performances [17]
- **Shakedown**: rare: 6 archived performances [17]
- **Samson**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 8 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-12-30.121396.mtx.tobin.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 156 min; rated 1.4/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls it a decent source, especially compared to other circulating copies of this show; Reviewer says it's closer to soundboard but still sounds like a good audience recording [10][11]
- **gd80-12-30.rolfe.munder.13300.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 159 min; rated 3.57/5 by 7 [2]
- **gd1980-12-30.146511.aud.flac2448**: audience recording; 21 songs; 155 min [3]. Said about its sound: The P.A. mix improves after the first few songs, starting around Beat It On Down The Line [3]
- **gd1980-12-30.senn421-walker.scotton-miller.90468.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 4 songs; 20 min [4]. Said about its sound: Setup was done on the fly mid-soundcheck, and the empty hall gives lots of boom [4]

## Around the show

- An acoustic soundcheck at this show included Youngblood and Searchin', which weren't played during the next night's acoustic set [8]
- The soundcheck recording includes It's All Over Now, Baby Blue and To Lay Me Down [4]
- Reviewer thinks this show is not better than the New Year's show [5]
- Reviewer says the pre-NYE shows on this run had especially crisp first sets [8]
- Reviewer rates this show better than the New Year's show [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-12-30.121396.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Source: Matrix (50/50) using mono sbd from video mixed with (shnid = 13300): AUD (nak 300's); Mixed by an archive.org user; FLAC conversion 17-JUL-2012 [1]
- **gd80-12-30.rolfe.munder.13300.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Nak 300's [2]. Also: Reviewer's own audience tape: about a third back, center by the soundboard, Audio Technica 811 mics into a JVC KD-2 with noise reduction [9]
- **gd1980-12-30.146511.aud.flac2448**: taped by Unknown via Richie & Rip; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Source: AUD of unknown lineage > Lo-gen cassette via Richie & Rip. [3]. Also: Patches from the ID-13300 source cover Friend of the Devil, Deal and two spots in Drums [3]
- **gd1980-12-30.senn421-walker.scotton-miller.90468.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master -> Cassette D [4]. Also: Tape came from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; Joe B. Jones helped with pitch correction; possibly one more cassette generation [4]
